name: Sony PTZ cameras (VISCA over IP)
notes: Complete list: 191 actions (src/actions.js: getPanTiltActionDefinitions, getLensActionDefinitions, getExposureActionDefinitions, getColorActionDefinitions, getPresetActionDefinitions, getMiscActionDefinitions, merged in getActionDefinitions) and 21 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js). All keys are written as object literal properties; nothing is generated in loops. Variables and presets (src/variables.js, src/presets.js) are not catalogued.

Protocol: Sony VISCA over IP, sent as UDP datagrams (src/visca.js) to Target IP or Hostname, default port 52381 (src/config.js). Camera Id dropdown ids are the strings 128 to 136 (default 129 = "id 1"). Config fields also include the camera model (default MODELS[0] = other_min) and the frame rate (60, 50 or 24; default 60).

Model filtering: actions and feedbacks with a `models` set (capability sets CAP_* in src/model-caps.js) are registered only when the configured model id is in the set. Entries without `models` are universal. Model "other_all" registers everything, model "other_min" (the default!) registers only the universal entries. The availability text of each entry lists the models of its set (label and model id). Registration is recomputed when the configuration changes (src/main.js).

Model groups for the choice tables (src/models.js): 1a = BRC-X400, BRC-X401, SRG-201M2, SRG-HD1M2, SRG-X120, SRG-X400, SRG-X402 and the two "other" models; 1b = SRG-H40UH, SRG-X40UH; 2 = BRC-H780, BRC-H800, BRC-X1000; 3a = SRG-120DH; 3b = SRG-201SE, SRG-300SE, SRG-301SE; 3c = SRG-280SHE, SRG-360SHE; 3d = SRG-300H; 4 = ILME-FR7, ILME-FR7K; 5 = SRG-A40, SRG-A12; 6 = BRC-AM7. Groups 3c and 3d reuse the 3b tables, group 6 reuses the group 4 tables.

Model- and frame-rate-dependent dropdowns (IRIS, GAIN, GAIN_LIMIT, SHUTTER, MAX_SHUTTER, BRIGHTNESS) are filled from src/choices.js at runtime. They are catalogued with choicesNote (per-group summary of count, first and last id, default), valueType string and valuePattern ^[0-9A-F]{2}$ (every id of every table is a two-digit upper-case hex string); the full tables are not enumerated. The SHUTTER and MAX_SHUTTER tables are chosen by the frame rate setting (60, 50, 24); a frame rate without a table falls back to the 50 table.

Static dropdowns (SPEED, LENS_SPEED, PRESET, RAMP_CURVE, EXPOSURE_COMPENSATION) are listed in full. CHOICES.PRESET has the numeric ids 1 to 64 (numbers, not strings) plus the string id "ps" (Use presetSelector Variable); most other dropdown ids are hex or digit strings such as "0C", "1", "2". Do not rely on number/string equivalence.

Options marked "Only present when ..." (the Step option of irisAdjust and gainAdjust) are added at registration time for the FR7/AM7 models only. The whiteBal action changes name, choices and default for those models (see its description); the tally colour list also depends on the model. The catalog records the union of the lists and describes the split in choicesNote.

Several numeric options are number fields with min/max; others are text inputs. Choice entries in the source carry an extra `default: true` flag (for example SPEED 0C); the catalog records it only through the option default or the choicesNote.
wbModeStandard and wbModeFr7 are hidden helper variants of whiteBal (hideFromHelp in the source) with their own model sets. ptSpeedS is a legacy action kept for old presets.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.11.0 (1.x): options do not support expressions.
Extracted statically with the TypeScript compiler API (constants, CHOICES, model sets and Array.from spreads resolved, no code executed). Not tested against a camera or a running Companion instance.
